messages:
mike: FYI acme tenant (tenant-acme-47) is seeing intermittent 504s on Dedicated eu-west-1. Customer gave request_id req_9f2b3a1c. Generation aborts after ~120 tokens, then connection reset.

rami: @mike can you paste the curl they used? need to reproduce from our staging nodes.

mike: From customer:
curl -v -H 'Authorization: Bearer [REDACTED]' -H 'X-Request-Id: req_9f2b3a1c' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-7b","input":"<redacted long prompt>","max_tokens":512,"stream":false}' \
  https://dedicated.eu-west-1.redwood.ai/v1/generate

They also reported the pod: pod/inference-redwood-624f on node gpu-node-az3-07.

elaine: @mike I'm going to collect a debug bundle from the node. Which tenant? Any PCI/PII in that request? If not we can upload to our debug S3.

mike: Tenant is acme (tenant-acme-47). Customer confirms no PII in that sample. Please include kernel dmesg, nvidia-smi, pod logs, container env, L4 proxy traces, /var/log/kern.log and /opt/redwood/runtime/trace/*.json.

elaine: Starting bundle now. Command I'm running on node:

```
sudo /opt/redwood/bin/collect_debug_bundle.sh \
  --tenant tenant-acme-47 \
  --request req_9f2b3a1c \
  --pods inference-redwood-624f \
  --node gpu-node-az3-07 \
  --include nvidia-smi,dmesg,kube-describe,kvcache,proxy-traces
```
ETA ~7m.

infra-bot: Collect job started: job_id dbg-20240421-77. Artifacts being gathered: pod_logs.tar, nvidia_smi.txt, dmesg.txt, kube_describe.txt, metrics_prom.zip

elaine: Quick findings while collecting: kernel shows 'NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:04:00): 31' — transient GPU ECC/driver error. Also saw OOM killer activity inside container: 'Killed process 2389 (runtime) total-vm: 3.2G'. Adding iostat/top for disk spikes.

jordan: @elaine can you also grab node perf counters and iostat? want to see if disk latency correlates with the eviction.

elaine: Added iostat and iotop. Uploading bundle to S3: s3://redwood-debug-uploads/acme/req_9f2b3a1c/dbg-20240421-77.tar.gz

infra-bot: Upload complete: https://s3.eu-west-1.amazonaws.com/redwood-debug-uploads/acme/req_9f2b3a1c/dbg-20240421-77.tar.gz

mike: Thanks. Next steps: ask customer to replay with header `X-Debug: true` and paste curl output. Also we'll pull monitoring metrics for gpu-node-az3-07 — early look shows memory_util spike and encoder cache misses around the times.

rami: I'll open a ticket with HW team referencing Xid 31 and include the bundle link. @jordan can you run a cordon+drain on a staging replica and run the repro to validate eviction behavior?

jordan: On it. Repro curl tip: use `--data-binary` to preserve whitespace and set `-H 'X-Debug: true' -H 'X-Request-Id: req_REPRO_9f2b'`. Also use a max_tokens ~256 to match customer seq length.

mike: :thumbsup: I'll coordinate with customer to run the repro and paste results back here. If they can attach the client-side timing that helps (connect, first-byte, total).
thread_summary: Debug bundle collected for tenant-acme-47 after 504s/generation aborts; kernel Xid 31 and container OOM seen; bundle uploaded to S3; infra and HW ticketing underway; repro instructions shared with customer.
